gauge.name: Tuckasegee River at sr1172 nr Cullowhee

impacts.statement: SOME HOMES AND BUILDINGS WILL BEGIN TO FLOOD NEAR THE GAGE SITE.
SOME HOMES AND BUSINESSES NEAR CULLOWHEE WILL BE AFFECTED.
LOW LYING AREAS ALONG PARTS OF HIGHWAY 107 ALONG THE RIVER WILL BEGIN TO FLOOD.
CALL DUKE POWER TO SEE HOW MANY GATES ARE OPEN AND DISCHARGE.  PASS THIS ON TO LMRFC.  5000 CFS OR MORE WILL CAUSE MINOR FLOODING DOWNSTREAM AND AT BRYSON CITY.

dataAttribution.title: Observations courtesy of U.S. Geological Survey
